title: On classical doubling method gamma factors for certain depth zero representations
summary: Piatetski-Shapiro--Rallis discovered an integral representation construction, known as the doubling method, for the tensor product $L$-function of a cuspidal automorphic representation of $G \times \mathrm{GL}_1$, where $G$ is a classical group. Lapid--Rallis defined and studied the counterpart local factors. In this article, following Lapid--Rallis, we define and study an analogous doubling method gamma factor associated to irreducible representations of classical finite groups of Lie type.
